name: Scarmoor Church
story: Centuries ago, an unknown entity took all the priests overnight. The church was haunted until a noble girl snuck inside, becoming possessed by the creature and attacking any who tresspassed in the chuch grounds. Brave soldiers eventually entered and subdued the creature, however its taint remains on the land to this day.

On occasion, a resident living near the church will be haunted by dreams of a womans voice calling out to them, many believe the voice to be the soul of the possessed girl, still bound to the church even after the passing of centuries.
truth: The priests were taken by the scourge prior to the scourge empress being trapped in stasis, the girl was scourged and eventually killed, however the scourge nest beneath the city remains
The nest has polluted the water in the wells, so occasionally townspeople hear the sleeping Scourge Queen's voice
